purpose: S10-7.4 B2 historical comparator: the SHARED command subset only (D7 slice text: sh, ls cat echo ps kill, idle redraw), run on the same retained headless harness (exact prompt, exact echo, idle sampler, status selection).
source_of_original_order: runtime/run.py run_one(): ready -> sample_idle('ordinary-prompt-idle') -> streams() [finite-stream, endless-collected-cat, endless-terminal-stream, rg-large] -> top_idle() [interactive-top, interactive-top-idle] -> phase('complete') + snapshot('complete'). The kept phases below preserve that relative order (ready, idle, finite commands, complete).

deadlines.note: identical to the original harness; no deadline is raised or added for B2

idle.sampler: common.Surface.sample_idle (10 Hz target, whole-QEMU CPU ticks, serial byte count)

status_selection: observer-memory/status_select.select_status (row after this command's own echo; fail closed on missing/duplicate)

memory.snapshot_at: every kept phase (initial-prompt, ordinary-prompt-idle, each finite command, complete)
memory.measured_tasks: B2 shell (persistent) at every snapshot; ls/cat/echo/ps/kill are observed only if a spawn is caught at an entry stop and its stacks are still present at a snapshot
per_task: mapped regions (ELF PT_LOAD, user stack, kernel stack, heap arena HEAP_MEM)
user-stack and kernel-stack sentinel watermark (0xA5, test-hooks kernel)
pre-run verify_primed proof at the entry stop
memory.allocator_peak: NOT MEASURED for B2: the B2 shell has no Cellbox heapwatch/allocator guard hooks

phases.name: initial-prompt
phases.justification: Shared: exact initial 'Cellos > ' prompt via the retained exact-idle predicate; B2 prints the same prompt literal (boot smoke: 'USER: Cellos > ').

phases.name: ordinary-prompt-idle
phases.justification: Shared: idle redraw at the prompt, 10 s x 100 samples, identical sampler.

phases.name: b2-echo
phases.justification: Shared command `echo`; replaces the role of the original finite typed command (a typed line that returns to the prompt). B2 `echo` is a shell builtin (executor.rs dispatch_builtin).

phases.name: b2-ls
phases.justification: Shared command `ls`; root listing is served by the VFS service/BootFS, present in both builds.

phases.name: b2-cat
phases.justification: Shared command `cat` of an existing file: /etc/cellos/system.toml is in the B2 headless kernel_fs.img (static-verification: image has /etc/cellos/system.toml with explicit [logging]).

phases.name: complete
phases.justification: Shared: final snapshot, as the original schedule.

on_status_mismatch_justification: B2 command semantics have never been executed on this harness (no VM run of b2-headless exists); a non-zero status or a missing expected row is a comparator fact, not a harness failure, and the one-run budget (D7-3) makes stopping lose the later phases. Status SELECTION failures (missing/duplicate/ambiguous row) still STOP (fail closed) as in the original harness.

dropped.reason: needs `top --records`, `to jsonl` and typed pipelines: Cellbox features that do not exist in B2 (B2 `top` is a builtin TUI loop without --records/to jsonl).
same missing features; additionally B2 `cat` without a path returns at once from an empty stdin (commands.rs cmd_cat), so there is no cancellable collected-cat to Ctrl-C.
needs `top --records` and `to jsonl`; no B2 equivalent.
B2 has no `rg`, and the b2-headless run attaches no /mnt/sd data disk.
B2 `top` is a different, builtin TUI (not the Cellbox record+TUI); the original oracle (cell_row_drawn) targets the candidate renderer. Excluded to keep the subset to shared commands.
depends on interactive-top; also its Ctrl-C/status-130 recovery is the cancel path that B2 cannot exercise without top/cat streaming.
no cancellable shared command exists in B2 (cat returns immediately); not simulated with a different command to avoid a non-shared workload.
